source_append.intent: Idempotent append/revision of one authorized true chat message
source_append.atomicity: source commit and idempotency receipt share the domain transaction

hold_operation.intent: Wrap the existing formal hold without changing memory semantics
hold_operation.result_lookup: authorized lookup of a known operation, not semantic search for a similar bucket
hold_operation.atomicity: memory creation and completed operation result in same domain transaction
hold_operation.existing_source_binding: memory.hold does not accept nonempty raw_refs; use source.bind
hold_operation.unknown_result: never regenerate a random key and retry blindly

source_bind.scope: exact existing memory and authorized source message range
source_bind.revision_requirement: stable immutable source version or explicit revision verification; unverified version cannot be called exact
source_bind.multi_range: one or more distinct verified bindings, track separately

bootstrap.reuse: current authorized profile/entry_source and legal returned projection

scope_guard: First prove an existing capability is sufficient before implementing anything new.
Missing remote contracts need the corresponding repository authorization and a minimal patch; no direct DB writes.
These runtime receipt fields do not reintroduce the retired recall budget/operation state machinery.
